title: Finite balanced scalar comparison on all complexes
statement: For a prime ell, finite coefficient extensions E and L with embedding iota, a scheme W, ordinary quotient model M [def-trf-completion-unit-models], scalar systems A with finite scalar evaluations rho [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation], and finite balanced associations [stage3-pur-finite-extension-association], define direct to be degreewise sequence scalar extension after M.quotient. Define directEvaluation at n by composing rho after M.tensor, finite scalar extension of M.evaluation, and association, then applying this natural module isomorphism degreewise to every complex. Naturality supplies chain-map and complex-map compatibility; the existing successor theorem applies to every complex.

source.place: 03D7, ordinary scalar-extension adjunction; 03EK, tensor products. Fully proved ordinary substep of the strict scalar quotient comparison.

proof.text: Compose the three given module isomorphisms. Their naturality gives the differential and complex-map equations needed for NatIso.ofComponents and HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents. The degree component equation is definitional. The directTransition theorem is the existing successor compatibility specialized to these composites.

Retain the actual coefficient-evaluation scalar-action calculation: rewrite its ring eqToHom on sections to identity. Convert the evaluated scalar-unit HEq to equality in the native finite carrier, then use this action identity to transport its scalar multiples. These are fully proved helpers, separated so each native-carrier identification is checked once.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary balanced tensor and adjunction-unit naturality; fully proved private implementation helper, not a new sorry obligation.

lean.statement:
def directEvaluation
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (association : ∀ n : ℕ,
      scalarReductionExtension l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
        integralScalarReduction l E L ι W n)
    (n : ℕ) :
    direct l E L ι W A M ⋙
      (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
        integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n
